name: ping
summary: Send ICMP ECHO_REQUEST to network hosts.
description: Test reachability of a host on an Internet Protocol (IP) network and measure round-trip time.

options.description: Stop after sending count ECHO_REQUEST packets.
Wait interval seconds between sending each packet.

examples.title: Ping host 4 times
examples.output:
PING 1.1.1.1 (1.1.1.1) 56(84) bytes of data.
64 bytes from 1.1.1.1: icmp_seq=1 ttl=57 time=12.4 ms
--- 1.1.1.1 ping statistics ---
4 packets transmitted, 4 received, 0% packet loss
examples.explanation: Sends 4 ICMP pings and reports latency statistics.

useCases: Testing network connectivity and packet loss
